description.en: Hamburg, officially the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, is the second-largest city in Germany after Berlin and sixth-largest city in the European Union, with a population of over 1.9 million. The Hamburg Metropolitan Region has a population of over 5.1 million and is the tenth-largest metropolitan region by GDP in the European Union.
description.zh-CN: 漢堡，全称汉堡汉萨自由市，位于德国北部的港口城市。汉堡拥有近189万人口，是仅次于柏林的德国第二大城市，欧盟第八大城市。
description.zh-TW: 漢堡，全稱漢堡漢薩自由市，位於德國北部的港口城市。漢堡擁有近189萬人口，是僅次於柏林的德國第二大城市，歐盟第八大城市。
